annotations.text:
The behaviour change.

Today the league summary reads no point at all — dnd-kit's default matches the dragged row's rectangle, so the target lands below the finger and the copy lands on it.

The fix reads a point 64px above the thumb. The two card boards below need the same idea, applied differently: their hit test already matches on x, so only the thumb moves.

The teal marks are debug only.

The crosshair, the dashed guides and the thumb circle are here so you can see where the hit test reads. None of them are drawn in the app.

The red marks are real: the insert bar and the faint cursor marker already ship on the dex pages.

Column drags are the easy case.

Both card surfaces already match on x alone, so the finger never has to sit on a sprite. Putting the thumb below the card is what keeps the copy off it too.
